keyFindings.description: The review margin's own pin write still answers a refusal with a bare invalidateQueries, so the optimistic pin reverts silently. Not a regression - every margin pin has behaved this way on main - but this change gives that path a second item kind through the Pinned tab's conversation Unpin (useMarginSheet.ts:605, PinnedTab.tsx:41-46), so it is now the one pin surface the new usePinWrites hook does not cover. Named as the round's fast-follow, a follow-up on the margin rather than a change to this pull request, since the margin's behaviour was deliberately held still.

pinnedMessages is one Promise.all over N getMessage reads, so a single failed read rejects the whole query and every pinned conversation card built from a message drops silently (pinnedCards returns [] for a marker whose record is missing, and no isError is read); PinnedTab can then print `No pinned items.` while dismissed still holds the markers. Transient only: no route deletes a message (no DELETE in routes_table.go for messages), so a permanent 404 is unreachable, and React Query refetches.

enqueue stores the caller's worker only on the branch that creates the per-issue entry and never refreshes it, so a pin made on one tab while the other tab's write is still in flight has its refusal reported to the other tab's banner. The entry is deleted on drain (:282), so the window is a single in-flight write, and the mechanism predates this change; what this change adds is a second pin surface on the same page.

The reply anchor is a document-wide querySelector over `[data-reply][aria-current="true"]`, an attribute three features now write, and the latch is left unset when the named reply can never mount, so a card whose ask-thread read errored is re-centred on every change of `shown`. Both edges are narrow; recorded in the PR body's Not proven / risk rather than held against the head.

An issue page with the Conversation open now reads the unpaged ask list twice: the thin row under ["asks", key] for the margin and the decision blocks, and the ?thread=1 row under ["asks", key, "thread"] for the tab. The deliberate trade for every document and Spec page reading no thread at all; a select over one key could collapse it later.
